title: AnalysisConfig — versioned, explicit, provenance-rich analysis configuration
description: Safe, explicit, versioned AnalysisConfig layer for parametric and nonparametric analyses (NB GLM, CLR/ILR+Gaussian LM, logistic in v1; BH mandatory; DANGER banner on overrides; DOI-ready bundles). From hyperpolymath/standards JSON + Nickel + DEED schemes.

schema_version.description: Semver schema version. Currently only 1.0.0 is supported.

id.description: Unique immutable identifier for this config (UUIDv4). Part of provenance chain.

created_by.description: User or system that created this config (for provenance)

method.description: Analysis method — explicit, no silent switching. NB_GLM for counts, CLR/ILR+LM for compositional, logistic for presence/absence.

formula.description: R-style formula containing '~', e.g. '~ group' or 'disease ~ group + batch'. Must reference only metadata_columns. Refuses empty or meaningless formulas.

outcome_column.description: Binary outcome column for logistic regression. Required for logistic, ignored for others unless formula uses it.

metadata_columns.description: Explicit list of metadata columns used. Must exist in study metadata. No auto-selection.

method.description: Normalization / transform. Must be compatible with method: nb_glm allows none/rarefy/size_factors/relative, clr_lm requires clr, ilr_lm requires ilr, logistic allows none/relative/rarefy/presence_absence.

pseudocount.description: Pseudocount for zero replacement in CLR/ILR. Must be >0. Typical 0.5. Refuses 0 because log(0) undefined.

ilr_basis.description: ILR basis. Only meaningful for ilr method. Refuses meaningless use for other methods.

method.description: BH mandatory in v1. Any override triggers DANGER banner and requires acknowledgment token.

allow_no_correction.description: If true, allows non-BH methods, but triggers DANGER banner and requires acknowledgment_token

advanced.description: All advanced options behind 'Advanced Analysis' expander, hidden unless Evidence Mode enabled. Heavy validation.

zero_handling.description: Zero handling. 'refuse' is DANGEROUS and requires acknowledgment token.

min_prevalence.description: Minimum prevalence filter in [0,1]. 0.1 = present in >=10% samples.

max_features.description: Max features to test. >100k refused as meaningless.

min_samples_per_group.description: Minimum samples per group for variance estimation. <2 refused, <3 triggers DANGER.

provenance.description: Provenance chain: metamanifold version, host, tools, etc. Enriched automatically.

hash.description: SHA256 of canonical JSON representation (immutable, content-addressed)

epistemic.description: Epistemic layer integration: avec_fibre column and present_in_every_admissible_world

avec_fibre.description: True if artefact carries enough semantic fibre to support inferences (Echo Types)

epistemic_status.description: Residual evidence status: Holds Present across all admissible worlds?
